# chameleon_tables (Data Source)

List all Iceberg tables in a namespace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "chameleon_tables" "raw" {
  catalog   = "analytics"
  namespace = "raw"
}

output "raw_table_names" {
  value = data.chameleon_tables.raw.names
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `catalog` (String)
- `namespace` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `names` (List of String) Table names.
